name: First Harvest
intent: The very first level, and the one that teaches the only input there is: tap a line to send its container. One board, so there is nothing to turn to and nothing to get wrong, and two colors so the pear is still recognisably a pear. A pointing hand taps the head of the middle lane; every lane head is yellow, so whichever line the player actually taps does something. The single green container sits behind the middle head, where it cannot be the first thing sent. Unloseable by construction.
